args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the contract (docstring)
and tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding. 2.665 now rounds to
2.66 instead of 2.67.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implements ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Fix
- Change `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Result
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` → `2.68`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` → `2.66` (banker's rounding)

## CI
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Note Decimal("2.675") quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 exact decimal → half even → 2.68 (since 7 is odd, round up to 8). 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). Correct.

Create branch, commit, run CI, wait, open PR.
